newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda January domestic vehicle output up.
newsitem.headline: Honda January domestic vehicle output up.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Thursday that its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas output in January rose as follows (with percentage comparisons from a year ago):
Honda said domestic output rose in January for a seventh consecutive month on a year-on-year basis, mainly helped by higher exports.
Honda said domestic sales rose for a 25th successive month on a year-on-year basis, due to robust demand for its Step Wagon recreational vehicles and its new Logo compact hatchback.
Exports rose for a fifth month in a row due to the start of exports of the CR-V light sports-utility vehicle to North America in January.
Overseas production rose for a 12th consecutive month due to higher output in North America and Asia, Honda said.
